messages:
emily: Heads-up: ACME reported a big p99 increase on /v1/chat.generate starting ~09:58 UTC, affecting a handful of dedicated customers. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/r/abc123 :rotating_light:
support-bot: Ticket #45321 created by support at 10:05, customer sees latency ~2-3x baseline and occasional 504s.
maria: I see the spike in p99 for chat-prod-us-west, tail latency correlated with longer contexts (>1024 tokens).
raj: Traces show a kernel fallback to SDPA for a subset of logits kernels after last night’s rollout. Kernel selector logs: "selected=sdpa_compat_path" for many longseq requests.
kevin: I pushed a buildflag change earlier (gcc LTO/opt-level bump) to try to reduce jitter; did we also touch flashattn compile settings?
kevin: yes - I flipped `FLASH_MATMUL_FASTPATH=1` in the canary image at 02:00.
emily: Could be an interaction where Flash path regresses on long sequences and we fall back to SDPA causing latencies to spike. Any quick mitigation?
raj: We can force kernel heuristic to prefer flashattn for this model family while we debug: set `kernel_priority=flash,sdpa` on the routing policy for chat-prod-us-west.
maria: Can we canary that change only for the affected customer? They’re on dedicated pool so yes, target their knode group.
oliver: I'm wary of flipping priority globally. Suggest roll a canary to 5% traffic to that pool and watch error budget + p99 for 30m.
kevin: Command to flip (on prod control plane):
```
PATCH /v1/runtime/policies/knode-group-42
{ "kernel_priority": ["flash", "sdpa"] }
```
I'll prepare the rollout script.
raj: Also capturing traces and full kv-cache sizes to repro locally. Repro steps so far: load test with seq len 1500, batch sizes 1-4, seed prompt from customer, run against canary image with/without flash opt.
emily: If canary looks good, we should roll to 100% for that kgroup and schedule a rollback plan. If not, temporary mitigation = pin to older runtime image (before FLASH_MATMUL_FASTPATH flip).
maria: I'll coordinate with support to notify customer about the mitigation and ETA.
kevin: Starting canary now (5% -> 20% over 15m). Watching metrics: p99 down slightly at 5%, need 15m steady state.
raj: Logging note: opened infra bug #8241 to track compileflag interaction. Will attach perf traces.
emily: Thanks. If anyone sees error >1% or error budget burn send :loudspeaker: and we'll abort.
support-bot: Update: Customer acknowledged mitigation plan, still impacted but monitoring.
maria: I'll post final status to #support when we have 30m of stable metrics.
kevin: Canary looks stable at 20m, p99 reverted to baseline for canary workers. Proceeding to 100% for that kgroup.
emily: Great—please keep an eye for regression elsewhere. After stable, let's schedule a root-cause postmortem to decide whether to revert the FLASH flag or patch the kernel selector heuristics.
